lines: Up next, an exciting announcement we have for you.
With us today is a fellow citizen and critically acclaimed author, Vesna Jessico, here to speak on her recent work, The Rights We Now Enjoy: How Svetka Gave Women the Right to Divorce.
So many women remain trapped in relationships with scummy, loyalist husbands, forced to support traitors.
They remain unaware of the changes in our society that Svetka has implemented.
Your work helps promote this new legal information to those women, bringing in fellow citizens under the right cause.
Tell us, how did you do it?
How did you manage to write such a fantastic piece of literature once again?
